comments: In view of the title (spelled dbu ma'i gnang ba in the manuscript colophon) this manuscript corresponds to item No. 16017 in [8H6M69W4]. This item is recorded to have 39 folios, and the author is given as "bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan" (like the following item No. 16018). It is possible that No. 16017 contained, in addition to the topical outline, bSod nams rgyal mtshan's more extensive commentary on that text (ID:7298).
